raw_output: {"essay": "Our irrigation system broke during the worst week of last July. I was the only person at home. I had seen my father fix it maybe twice. I got it to work after about nine hours. It broke again two days later. This was because I fixed the symptom and not the pump seal. The second repair took forty minutes. By then, I actually understood the system. Nine hours of guessing compared to forty minutes of knowing. That comparison stayed with me more than anything I learned in a classroom that year."}

{"essay": "I lost a debate round that I should have won. This happened because I would not admit that a small point was clearly wrong. I spent three minutes defending it. Then I ran out of time for my main argument. The judge's note said, roughly, that I defended the least important thing I said. I have gotten better at giving up points on purpose. It still feels like losing every single time."}

{"essay": "I faced a challenge during my sophomore year. I broke my wrist. Because of this, I could not play baseball. It was hard. I was sad about it for a while. I learned that you have to keep going even when things are hard. I also learned that everything happens for a reason. Now I try to have a positive attitude about things. That is what I learned from my challenge."}

{"essay": "My challenge is working many hours. It is hard for me to finish my homework. Sometimes I am at work until 11. Then I still have to do my assignments. I have learned that time management is important. I want to go to school. Someday I want to open my own salon and not have to work for other people."}

{"essay": "One challenge I overcame was feeling anxious about speaking in front of people. I joined drama club. This sounds strange, but it helped. I am still nervous, but I can do it now. I want to study psychology. I am interested in why people are the way they are. I also want to help people like me."}

{"essay": "I make beats. I have put out music that people actually listen to. My challenge is that school never felt connected to any of that. Because of that, I did not try very hard for a long time. I am trying harder now. I run sound at my church every Sunday. That is where I learned mixing. I want to study music production. I want to do this for real."}
